_about: The stages of a building's destruction (docs/world/staged-destruction.md; WorldStructures.stage). Stage 0 is intact and 4 is rubble (not alive), fixed in code. hpAt: the share of its hit points a building must fall under to reach stage 1 (windows out), 2 (a part gone) and 3 (a shell). cutFloorsStage: the stage a skyscraper with a cut floor is at least in.
